label: И
description: Additive sentences that train how Russian chains ideas with 'and'.

missions.phrase: Я читаю книгу и пишу заметки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two linked actions. 1. 'И' joins 'читаю' and 'пишу' under one first-person subject. 2. Each verb keeps its own object, 'книгу' and 'заметки'. 3. A clean model of additive coordination.

missions.phrase: Ты идёшь по парку и слушаешь музыку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Parallel actions. 1. 'Ты' holds both 'идёшь' and 'слушаешь' in second person singular. 2. 'И' coordinates the two simultaneous activities. 3. Trains smooth chaining of verbs.

missions.phrase: Он берёт книгу и сумку со стола.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One subject, two objects. 1. 'Берёт' governs the joined pair 'книгу и сумку'. 2. 'И' links the two accusative objects under one verb. 3. Everyday carrying language.

missions.phrase: Мы покупаем хлеб и молоко в магазине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shopping list logic. 1. 'Мы покупаем' is a common present-tense frame. 2. 'И' chains 'хлеб' and 'молоко' as a list. 3. Practical and easy to reuse.
Strategic focus: Joined subjects. 1. 'И' fuses 'мама' and 'папа' into one compound subject. 2. 'Сегодня дома' closes the sentence naturally. 3. Shows 'and' working at subject level.

missions.phrase: Дверь и окно в комнате открыты.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural predicate agreement. 1. 'И' joins 'дверь' and 'окно' into a plural subject. 2. 'Открыты' matches in the plural short form. 3. A solid agreement test.

missions.phrase: Из окна я вижу дом и сад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Visual object list. 1. 'Вижу' stays first person singular. 2. 'И' joins the two concrete objects 'дом' and 'сад'. 3. Simple yet dense enough to train focus.

missions.phrase: Он свободно говорит по-русски и по-английски.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Coordinated adverbs. 1. 'И' links 'по-русски' and 'по-английски' as two modes of speech. 2. Useful for bilingual contexts. 3. Reinforces the adverbial 'по-' pattern.

missions.phrase: Книга и тетрадь лежат на столе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Joined nouns with location. 1. 'И' pairs 'книга' and 'тетрадь' into a plural subject. 2. 'Лежат на столе' gives the shared location and plural verb. 3. An everyday visual scene.

missions.phrase: Они весь день работают и отдыхают.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Balanced activities. 1. 'Они' drives both 'работают' and 'отдыхают'. 2. 'И' coordinates the two third-person plural verbs. 3. A natural rhythm of daily life.
